I'll try to peer it with this 2 geth node testnet Any recent release will work (`brew install besu`), and you will need to run it with `--Xeip1559-enabled=true`). You can get the other 1559 options under `--Xhelp`. All experimental options are there. excellent, thank you You may need to set these other options: ``` --Xeip1559-basefee-max-change-denominator=<basefeeMaxChangeDenominator> --Xeip1559-enabled=<eip1559Enabled> Enable experimental EIP-1559 fee market change (default: false) --Xeip1559-initial-base-fee=<initialBasefee> --Xeip1559-migration-duration-in-blocks=<migrationDurationInBlocks> ``` I'm not 100% sure, sorry 😕 possibly a config issue, but besu fails when reading geths 1559 fork block (#3): `java.util.concurrent.CompletionException: org.hyperledger.besu.ethereum.eth.sync.tasks.exceptions.InvalidBlockException: Failed to import block: Invalid block at #3 (0x90d2b8945cfe749e7cab84ae4fab0d7bd8ac755e6bbd77d65a26b453feaf8bd6)` full stack trace: i'm starting besu up with this: ``` ./bin/besu-1.5.0/bin/besu --data-path=besu-sync --genesis-file=besu-genesis.json --bootnodes={INSERT} --p2p-port=30305 --Xeip1559-enabled=true --Xeip1559-basefee-max-change-denominator=8 --Xeip1559-decay-range=1000000 --Xeip1559-initial-base-fee=1000000000 --Xeip1559-per-tx-gas-limit=8000000 --Xeip1559-slack-coefficient=2 --Xeip1559-target-gas-used=10000000 ``` all the setup commands can be found here: https://hackmd.io/@matt/Hy28zgpHD add --logging=DEBUG so we can get why it rejected the block. this is with `--logging=DEBUG` (note that i restarted the nodes and therefore have a different header for block 3) I managed to rebase <@376568077950910466>'s 1559 work onto the ~latest go-ethereum head (https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/commit/fdd42d425b49383c4544314eba69b26f450b537b), it's currently in sync with the version that wasn't rebased (block 735 so far) I'll keep an eye on it to see if it continues to stay in sync. The diff can be viewed here: https://github.com/quilt/go-ethereum/pull/32

excerpts.content: <@!552133098075193354> where can i find the 1559-capable besu? I'll try to peer it with this 2 geth node testnet

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: Any recent release will work (`brew install besu`), and you will need to run it with `--Xeip1559-enabled=true`). You can get the other 1559 options under `--Xhelp`. All experimental options are there.

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content:
You may need to set these other options:
```
      --Xeip1559-basefee-max-change-denominator=<basefeeMaxChangeDenominator>

      --Xeip1559-enabled=<eip1559Enabled>
         Enable experimental EIP-1559 fee market change (default: false)
      --Xeip1559-initial-base-fee=<initialBasefee>

      --Xeip1559-migration-duration-in-blocks=<migrationDurationInBlocks>
```
